facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/aobj:.bss
facts.existing_value: At HSD object-system startup, HSD_AObjInitAllocData passes this descriptor, sizeof(HSD_AObj), and alignment 4 to HSD_ObjAllocInit. facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/aobj:.bss
facts.existing_value: The descriptor begins as zero-initialized BSS storage. Initialization resets it, installs unlimited default allocation limits, sets an alignment mask of 3 and an aligned HSD_AObj size, and registers it globally. Each successful allocation removes an entry from its free list, increments used, decrements free, and raises peak when necessary; freeing performs the inverse used/free transition and prepends the object to the free list.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/aobj:HSD_AObjSetFlags
facts.existing_value: For a non-null AObj, the operation can only transition AOBJ_LOOP and AOBJ_NO_UPDATE from clear to set; it cannot clear either bit or alter other playback-state bits. Once AOBJ_NO_UPDATE is set, FObj interpretation continues but receives no owning-object update callback.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/aobj:HSD_AObjSetRewindFrame
facts.existing_value: The setter itself performs no playback transition: it ignores a null AObj and otherwise changes only rewind_frame. During later interpretation, the value matters only when AOBJ_LOOP is set and curr_frame has reached or passed end_frame. If rewind_frame is below end_frame, playback wraps into [rewind_frame, end_frame), re-requests the wrapped frame from the FObjs, and sets AOBJ_REWINDED; if rewind_frame is at or beyond end_frame, curr_frame is clamped to end_frame and AOBJ_REWINDED is still set.
